what: Visibility of 'not in the square' in the 512x512 agentview the server sends (envs.render, JPEG q90), cube teleported to centre offsets (cm) from the square's centre on the table. Measured 2026-10-19 (lffbench/tasks/l5_slide.py, unchanged drawing: 6 cm inner square, 0.6 cm line).

definitions.overrun_px: rows (far side) / columns (left, right) of the cube's segmentation silhouette beyond the outer edge of the green line, median over the cube's interior columns (far) or max over rows (sides)
definitions.line_gone: first offset at which the line has 0 visible px in every interior cube column
definitions.jpeg_red2: first offset at which >= 2 consecutive red pixels lie beyond the line's outer edge in the JPEG image (median over columns)

near_note: near line: 0 visible px in the cube's columns for every offset from -4.0 to +2.8 cm on all 5 main seeds (the cube's body hides it); the only near-side cue is the green gap in front of the cube
